name: La Carlota (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Carlota (the monogram of Charles III on blue above trees on white) surrounded by the inscription Real Carlota capital de las nuevas poblaciones de Andalucía in green.
history: Municipal flag of La Carlota; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Carlota arms — monogram of Charles III above trees
circular inscription Real Carlota capital de las nuevas poblaciones de Andalucía
